name: Rime Seer
rules: Summon Rime Seer: 10 HP / 4 Power. Attacks apply 3 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon a 10 HP / 4 Power Thrall. Attacks apply 3 Chill.
